ratings.notes: Guarded is interpreted as reserved, not protective.
Mighty can imply social power or rank.
Bossy suggests command and possible domination.
Barbaric can imply brutality; civilized suggests refinement.
Insecure is interpreted as self-doubt, not physical safety.
Democratic relates to equality; authoritarian to hierarchy and restriction.
Both poles directly match purity/degradation language.
Frugal/lavish relate to self-discipline versus indulgence.
Self-disciplined directly matches the purity foundation.
